# Ameen Chopra

> Ameen Chopra is a web developer and Instagram manager in Malaysia. He builds websites, manages Instagram accounts and creates WebAR 3D menus for cafes, restaurants and other local businesses. Prices are in Malaysian ringgit (RM) and the exact price is confirmed in writing before work starts.

How to contact or hire him: send a message to @amxxn47 on Instagram (https://instagram.com/amxxn47) or email ameenchopra5911@gmail.com.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://ameenchopra410.github.io/web-development.html): Fast, mobile-friendly websites. About RM 800 to 1,100 for 1-3 pages, RM 1,100 to 1,600 for 4-6 pages, RM 1,600 to 2,300 for 7-10 pages, RM 4,000 to 6,000 for booking or advanced features, RM 8,000 to 12,000 for e-commerce.
- [Instagram Management](https://ameenchopra410.github.io/instagram-management.html): Monthly plans for posts, reels, stories, replies and growth. Basic RM 1,800, Standard RM 2,000, Pro RM 2,800 and Premium RM 3,700 per month. Ad budget is paid by the client.
- [WebAR 3D Menu](https://ameenchopra410.github.io/webar-3d-menu.html): Customers scan a QR code on the table and see a 3D model of the dish on their table through the phone camera, with no app needed. RM 1,700 for 10-20 dishes up to RM 4,500 for 50-60 dishes.
- [Graphic Design](https://ameenchopra410.github.io/graphic-design.html): Social media posts, stories and visual branding. RM 500 to 1,500 depending on the plan.
- [Digital Strategy](https://ameenchopra410.github.io/digital-strategy.html): Basic SEO, content planning and brand growth ideas. RM 599 to 1,300 depending on the plan.
